name: Agency Tool Company

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: Official site: ATC Build (coming soon) = CI runner on hosted NVIDIA Jetson (Orin Nano, NX, AGX, Thor); Raspberry Pi, Rockchip and specialty x86 only on request ('Need something else? Reach out'). ATC Deploy (beta) is OTA software delivery/fleet management for robots, not compute. No published price.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Checked 2026-09-29: still no pricing, docs or signup; ATC Deploy 'IN BETA TODAY', install link 'withheld until launch'; ATC Build 'COMING SOON' as a GitHub Actions / GitLab CI runner ('runs-on: atc-build'). Waitlist only.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

isolation.quote: No emulation, no "worked on my machine" surprises... Use all the hardware, including CUDA, NVENC, DLA, and specialty accelerators, to make sure your software really works.
isolation.note: ATC Build runs CI jobs on hosted real NVIDIA Jetson boards (Orin Nano/NX/AGX/Thor), explicitly avoiding emulation/virtualization to expose real accelerators; no isolation mechanism (containers/VM) is documented, consistent with direct/bare-metal access to dedicated embedded hardware.

docker_inside.quote: Cached artifacts and Docker builds keep pipelines short, so devs and test techs stop waiting on pushes.
docker_inside.note: ATC Build supports Docker builds as part of the CI pipeline; ATC Deploy also ships OCI-compatible container images.

mcp_server.quote: Fast CLI for engineers and agents; ergonomic web console for operations.
mcp_server.note: Only a CLI and web console are mentioned for controlling ATC Deploy/Build; no MCP server is advertised anywhere on the site, blog, or llms.txt.

public_ipv4.quote: ATC Build is a CI runner backed by our hosted specialized embedded compute infrastructure.
public_ipv4.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — ATC Build is a CI job runner and ATC Deploy is an OTA fleet-management tool; neither is a network-addressable sandbox/VM product with exposed public IPs.

ingress_rules.quote: ATC Build is a CI runner backed by our hosted specialized embedded compute infrastructure.
ingress_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no inbound service/ports concept exists in a CI runner or OTA deployment product.

self_host.quote: ATC Build is a CI runner backed by our hosted specialized embedded compute infrastructure.
self_host.note: The Jetson build hardware and deployment service are described as hosted by Agency Tool Company; no self-hosted/on-prem deployment option is offered.

byoc.quote: ATC Build is a CI runner backed by our hosted specialized embedded compute infrastructure.
byoc.note: No mention of deploying the ATC control plane into a customer's own cloud account; the service is run by Agency Tool Company on hardware it hosts.

open_source.quote: Agency Tool Company gives robotics teams reliable infrastructure to build, deploy, manage, and operate real-world robots.
open_source.note: No OSI license or open-source repository is referenced for ATC Deploy or ATC Build; the products are presented as a proprietary hosted/beta commercial service.

hipaa.quote: Agency Tool Company builds deployment infrastructure for robotics teams: over-the-air updates, fleet management, and CI on real robot hardware.
hipaa.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a robotics OTA/CI deployment tool has no relation to protected health information workflows.

ssh.quote: Your engineers are up after midnight SSH’d into robots to upgrade the fleet.
ssh.note: not offered: SSH is described only as the manual pain-point ATC Deploy replaces on customers' own robots; no SSH access to ATC's hosted Jetson build machines or Deploy infrastructure is offered. Outside the product's scope.

snapshot.quote: ATC Build is a CI runner backed by our hosted specialized embedded compute infrastructure.
